objs.name: document
objs.description: A controlled information object subject to document management lifecycle including creation, editing, review, release, distribution, and archiving with version control and audit trail.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of document such as Policy, Guideline, Work Instruction, or Procedural Instruction

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Standardized abbreviation code for the document type

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the document

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the document in its lifecycle

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date when the document becomes valid

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date when the document expires or requires validity extension

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Time period for which validity check is necessary

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Primary creator and owner of the document

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Additional person with change rights on the document

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Person responsible for technical and formal review of document content

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Person responsible for approving and releasing the document

attributes.name: translator
attributes.description: Person responsible for translating document content to other languages

attributes.name: reader_group
attributes.description: User group assigned read authorization for the document

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents or master data

attributes.name: it_application
attributes.description: Information systems relevant to the document

attributes.name: company
attributes.description: Company or organizational entity for which document applies

attributes.name: area_of_validity
attributes.description: Scope of organizational units where document applies

attributes.name: client
attributes.description: Client or subsidiary in multi-client system where document is visible

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period for which document is retained before physical deletion

attributes.name: original_language
attributes.description: Primary language of the document content

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document that is automatically released with the main document, subject to own versioning and versioning of the associated main document, requiring review and release according to dual control principle.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the attachment in the release process

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date when the attachment expires with the main document

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: A document supplement not subject to the release cycle of the main document, released directly via switches in properties without affecting main document versioning.

attributes.name: published
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether additional information is published

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A request to amend an existing document without affecting the content or version history of the current document version.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Person who created the change proposal

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the change proposal

attributes.name: implementation_status
attributes.description: Whether the change proposal has been implemented or completed

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated request when a document reaches 30 days before validity expiration, requiring review and decision to extend validity, revise, or invalidate the document.

attributes.name: document
attributes.description: Reference to the document requiring validity check

attributes.name: requested_date
attributes.description: Date when the validity extension request was created

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to declare a document invalid and archive it when it no longer has validity and must be withdrawn from circulation.

attributes.name: document
attributes.description: Reference to the document being invalidated

attributes.name: applicant
attributes.description: Person who initiated the override request

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the override request

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to restore a previously invalidated and archived document to valid status during the archiving period.

attributes.name: document
attributes.description: Reference to the document being reactivated

attributes.name: initiator
attributes.description: Business Admin group member who created the reactivation request

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of user groups and persons assigned to receive document distribution through email notification or acknowledgement workflow.

attributes.name: user_group
attributes.description: Group of users assigned for distribution

attributes.name: person
attributes.description: Individual person assigned for distribution

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution - by email notification or by acknowledgement

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: A workflow-supported confirmation by a user that they have reviewed a document released with acknowledgement requirement.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Whether the acknowledgement has been confirmed

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A collection of users with assigned roles and permissions in the document management system.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the user group

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role assigned to the user group

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person with assigned roles and authorizations in the document management system.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the user

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role assigned to the user

attributes.name: authorization
attributes.description: Access rights granted to the user

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined format for a specific document type that can be selected when creating new documents and supports metadata integration through TAG technology.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Type of document for which this template applies

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: Original file format such as MS Word, Excel, or PowerPoint

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: An assigned task in the document approval workflow requiring user action and electronic signature.

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: Workflow step such as Creator, Review, or Release

attributes.name: assigned_to
attributes.description: User or users assigned to complete the workflow task

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the workflow task

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A digital signature documenting completion and authorization of a workflow task by a participant.

attributes.name: signer
attributes.description: Person who applied the signature

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when signature was applied

attributes.name: workflow_step
attributes.description: Workflow step at which the signature was applied

attributes.name: decision
attributes.description: Approval or rejection decision recorded with the signature
